::: {#perfil}

Deep learning researcher at the GAIA Lab since 2023, focused on remote sensing applied to agribusiness. MSc student in Applied Mathematics and Data Science at FGV EMAp, where he also earned his BSc in Data Science and AI. He works as a computer vision engineer at Audsat and was a research data scientist at IRB(Re).

## Education

- MSc in Applied Mathematics and Data Science — FGV EMAp, 2025–2026
- BSc in Data Science and AI — FGV EMAp, 2021–2024
- Technical degree in Informatics — IFSULDEMINAS, 2018–2020

## Interests

Artificial intelligence, remote sensing, and agribusiness.
